profile.name: Liu Liu
profile.title: Embodied World Models Lead
profile.bio_short: I am the Embodied World Models Lead at Horizon Robotics’ Horizon Labs, working on world action models, 3D generation, and scene understanding. I welcome research collaborations and applicants for World Model internships and full-time roles.
profile.bio_short_zh: 现任地平线机器人 Horizon Labs 具身世界模型负责人，研究世界动作模型、三维生成与场景理解。欢迎研究合作与技术交流，团队开放 World Model 方向实习及全职岗位。
profile.bio: I am the Embodied World Models Lead at Horizon Robotics’ Horizon Labs. I work on world action models, 3D generation, and scene understanding, building on earlier work in 3D perception, 4D labeling, and closed-loop simulation. I welcome research collaborations and technical exchange, and our team has internship and full-time openings in world models.
profile.bio_zh: 现任地平线机器人 Horizon Labs 具身世界模型负责人，研究世界动作模型、3D生成与场景理解。此前从事3D感知、4D标注与闭环仿真系统研发。欢迎研究合作与技术交流，团队开放世界模型方向实习及全职岗位。

research_focus.title: Unified World Action Models
research_focus.description: We aim to build unified language-world-action foundation models. Our work scales internet, egocentric, and robot data through automated annotation, while advancing control-oriented representations and instruction following.
research_focus.description_zh: 目标是构建统一的语言—世界—动作具身基础模型。通过自动标注扩展互联网、第一视角与机器人数据，研究面向控制的表征与指令遵从。

research_focus.title: 3D Generation & Interactive Environments
research_focus.description: We develop interactive 3D worlds for robot training and evaluation. Our work combines simulation-ready generation, in-place scene completion, and controllable digital twins for data and trajectory synthesis.
research_focus.description_zh: 面向机器人训练与评测，构建可交互的3D世界。结合仿真就绪的场景生成、原位补全与可控数字孪生，支持数据和操作轨迹合成。

research_focus.title: 3D Reconstruction & Understanding
research_focus.description: We develop feed-forward 3D foundation models for scene reconstruction and understanding. We study streaming geometry, instance understanding, and persistent spatial memory to support perception and closed-loop execution.
research_focus.description_zh: 面向具身Agent，研究前馈式3D基础模型，实现统一的场景重建与理解。结合流式几何、实例理解与持久化空间记忆，支持感知和执行闭环。

experience.summary: Lead embodied world model research, coordinating technical planning and the development of research prototypes into working systems.
experience.summary_zh: 负责具身世界模型方向的技术规划与研究协同，推进原型向可用系统转化。
highlights: Data and model development: advance multimodal data scaling and automated annotation, alongside semantic execution interfaces and control representations (CogWAM, ReWAM, Ego4WAM).
Simulation infrastructure: advance world generation, scene completion, and controllable digital twins for robot training and manipulation trajectory synthesis (EmbodiedGen / V2, 3D-Fixer, ManiSplat).

Spatial perception and memory: coordinate research on streaming 4D understanding and its 147K-sequence data system (IGGT4D), unified reconstruction and semantics (Uni3R), and persistent 3D memory (HoloAgent-0).
highlights_zh: 数据与模型研发：推进多模态数据扩展和自动标注，以及语义执行接口与控制表征研究（CogWAM、ReWAM、Ego4WAM）。
仿真基础设施：推进世界生成、场景补全与可控数字孪生研发，支持机器人训练和操作轨迹合成（EmbodiedGen / V2、3D-Fixer、ManiSplat）。
空间感知与记忆：协同推进流式4D理解及14.7万序列数据体系（IGGT4D）、统一重建与语义理解（Uni3R）、持久化3D空间记忆（HoloAgent-0）。

experience.role: Autonomous Driving 4D Labeling & Closed-loop Simulation Technical Lead
experience.role_zh: 自动驾驶4D标注与闭环仿真技术负责人
experience.summary: Led delivery of a production-grade vision-only 4D labeling system and Horizon's first 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline for closed-loop simulation and data synthesis.
experience.summary_zh: 带队交付工程化纯视觉4D标注系统，并主导地平线首个基于3D Gaussian Splatting的闭环仿真与数据合成系统。

experience.company_zh: 深圳奥比中光科技有限公司
experience.role_zh: 3D感知算法负责人 / 算法工程师
experience.summary: Led product development across monocular and stereo depth, LiDAR-camera fusion and calibration, ToF, and single-photon LiDAR systems.
experience.summary_zh: 负责单目/双目深度、LiDAR-Camera融合与标定、ToF及单光子LiDAR等产品的算法研发与工程落地。

service.label: Professional appointment
service.content: Committee Member, Technical Committee on 3D Vision, China Society of Image and Graphics (CSIG).
service.content_zh: 中国图象图形学学会（CSIG）三维视觉专业委员会委员。

service.label: Patents
service.content: Over 10 granted 3D vision patents in China and abroad, covering depth estimation, stereo matching, LiDAR-camera calibration, sensor synchronization, single-photon LiDAR ranging, and point cloud processing.
service.content_zh: 国内外3D视觉相关授权专利10余项，覆盖深度估计、立体匹配、LiDAR-Camera标定、传感器同步、单光子LiDAR测距与点云处理等。

service.label: Book contribution
service.content: Contributed to 《智能驾驶与多维重建》 (China Machine Press, 2025), covering 3D reconstruction, 4D labeling, mapping and localization, simulation, and visualization through industry practice.
service.content_zh: 参与编撰《智能驾驶与多维重建》（机械工业出版社，2025），结合产业实践介绍三维重建、4D标注、建图定位、仿真与可视化。

service.label: Peer review
service.content: Reviewer for conferences including CVPR, NeurIPS, AAAI, and IROS, as well as journals.
service.content_zh: 担任 CVPR、NeurIPS、AAAI、IROS 等会议及期刊审稿人。

open_source.title: HoloAgent-0
open_source.description: An embodied agent with 3D spatial memory for navigation and manipulation.
open_source.description_zh: 融合3D空间记忆、导航与操作的具身Agent。

open_source.title: EmbodiedGen V2
open_source.description: An agentic 3D world engine for simulation-ready scenes and assets.
open_source.description_zh: 面向仿真场景与资产生成的智能3D世界引擎。

news.content: Gave a technical talk at HKUST titled "Advancing World Action Models: From Scalable Experience to Robust and Efficient Robot Control".
news.content_zh: 在香港科技大学作技术分享：《Advancing World Action Models: From Scalable Experience to Robust and Efficient Robot Control》。

news.content: CogWAM, ReWAM, and Ego4WAM released, advancing semantic cognition, control representations, and egocentric data scaling.
news.content_zh: CogWAM、ReWAM 与 Ego4WAM 发布，推进语义认知、控制表征与第一视角数据扩展。

news.content: DreamWAM and Faster-WAM released, advancing robust and efficient world action models.
news.content_zh: DreamWAM 与 Faster-WAM 发布，推进更鲁棒、更高效的世界动作模型。
HoloAgent-0 与 EmbodiedGen V2 发布。

news.content: SimWeaver and IGGT4D project pages and paper released.
news.content_zh: SimWeaver 与 IGGT4D 项目主页及论文发布。

news.content: NoDrift3R and TabletopGen accepted to ECCV 2026.
news.content_zh: NoDrift3R 与 TabletopGen 被 ECCV 2026 接收。

news.content: Three papers accepted to CVPR 2026: Uni3R (highlight), 3D-Fixer, and RoboTransfer.
news.content_zh: 三篇论文被 CVPR 2026 接收：Uni3R（Highlight）、3D-Fixer 与 RoboTransfer。
IGFuse 被 AAAI 2026 Oral 接收。

news.content: EmbodiedGen and RoboTransfer project pages and repositories went live in the Robot Lab ecosystem.
news.content_zh: EmbodiedGen 与 RoboTransfer 项目主页和代码仓库在 Robot Lab 生态中上线。
